title: 하루 일과 말하기: 씻고, 먹고, 가요
objective: By the end, you can join two verbs, adjectives, or nouns with -고 and use it to talk about two things or two steps in order, such as your daily routine.
summary: This worksheet teaches how to use -고 to join two actions or two descriptions into one sentence ("and" / "and then").

task.title: Join sentences with -고
task.line: Use -고 to fill in, choose, combine, or answer, as each question asks.

forms.when: Take off 다 and add 고. It is the same with or without a final consonant.
forms.exampleMeaning: On weekends I clean and do the laundry.

forms.form: Verb stem + 고 (first A, then B)
forms.when: Use it for two steps that happen in order.
forms.means: "and then": the first action happens first.
forms.exampleMeaning: I wash my hands and then eat.

forms.when: Use it to describe one thing in two ways.
forms.exampleMeaning: This restaurant is cheap and the food is good.

forms.when: Use 이고 after a final consonant. Use 고 after a vowel (이고 is also OK).
forms.exampleMeaning: I am a student, and my younger sibling is an office worker.

forms.when: For past steps ("and then"), keep -고 as it is. Use the past tense only on the last verb.
forms.exampleMeaning: Yesterday I did my homework and then went to bed.

watchOut: 먹어고 (X) → 먹고 (O): Add 고 straight to the stem. Just take off 다.
공부해고 (X) → 공부하고 (O): For 하다 words, use 하고, not 해고.
학생고 (X) → 학생이고 (O): After a noun that ends in a consonant, use 이고.
만났고 영화를 봤어요 → 만나고 영화를 봤어요: Both are grammatical, but for "and then" in the past, it is more natural to add 았/었 only to the last verb.
exercises: Fill in the blank with 읽다 + -고: 저녁에 책을 ____ 음악을 들어요.
Choose the right word: 이 가방은 (가볍고 / 가벼워고) 예뻐요.
Fill in the blanks with 이고 or 고: ① 제 친구는 의사____ 제 동생은 가수예요. ② 저는 미국 사람____ 제 남편은 한국 사람이에요.
Combine the two sentences into one with -고: 어제 이를 닦았어요. 그리고 잤어요.
Answer in Korean with -고, using 샤워하다 and then 옷을 입다: 아침에 뭐 해요?
Write O if the sentence is correct and X if it is wrong. Fix the wrong one: ① 이 방은 크고 밝아요. ② 일요일에 운동해고 쉬어요.
answers: 샤워하고 옷을 입어요. (아침에 샤워하고 옷을 입어요.)
① O ② X → 일요일에 운동하고 쉬어요.
